title: It was great to see................................
text: It was great to see the remnants of what once a thriving Jewish community.  Our tour guide, Jon, was personable, very well prepared, and friendly.  Please note that while this tour was not described as a walking tour it was.  Lots of hilly narrow streets.  If you have a mobility issue this tour is not for you.
author: Stu_D

title: Lovely morning
text: Miriana was excellent - interesting and friendly. I liked the pace of the tour. There was a variety of experiences
author: Janice_N

title: Excellent Tour  Making the both Jewish area of Lisbon and the City of Lisbon come alive.  One of best tours ever.
text: Excellent Guide. Daniel made the tour memorable for my wife and me. We loved his personal stories and how he related these stories to the historic Jewish Community.  He was so patient and careful with us as we climbed the stairs and maneuvered around the winding streets. Very impressive tour and very impressive guide,  In our 50 years plus travels in Europe and Asia. thjs tour ranks in the top of the list. It helped make the historic Jewish section as well as the city of Lisbon come alive in so many ways. We wish Daniel could lead tours for us in other cities and in other major attractions.
author: Donald_R

title: Great tour and great way to start our Barcelona adventure
text: Hugo was an excellent guide for our tour of the Jewish Quarter - he was very knowledgeable and easy going.
author: David_S

title: Informational and educational for any age or faith.
text: Roger was our guide and was very knowledgeable. It included history as far back as the Roman Empire, And the interrelationships of Christianity and the Jewish people.
author: wmahlik

title: Barcelona Jewish Tour
text: Roger, our tour guide, was very prompt, friendly, and courteous.  He was also very knowledgeable about what relatively little is known about the history of the Jewish Quarter.  Jewish life stopped in 1492, but Roger did point out what is left and was very informative.
author: Julie_K

title: Jewish Quarter of Barcelona. Private tour
text: This tour was excellent. It was a private tour - just me + my 20 yr old son. Marc was our guide. He was very engaging + knowledgable. Everything he discussed was relevant and interesting. He met us at our hotel and brought us to the Jewish Quarter. That was key because a friend of mine never found it when she was there!! I highly recommend this tour. It was the highlight of our stay in Barcelona!
author: nancyT1432CG

title: Great tour in Jewish Quarter
text: Ramon was incredibly knowledgeable. We learned so much and the history was fascinating. Terrific tour. So neat to see the old synagogue.
author: njc0hen

title: Jewish Quarter was a first place we wanted to see in Barcelona.
text: Jorge, our tour guide came on time and picked us up from our hotel as we have been promised. His knowledge about the history and the little streets we walked on was incredible. He was kind, funny and respectful. After our tour ended he even pointed us close by point of interestsas well. We strongly recommend this tour especially with Jorge.
author: Esti_S

title: Wonderful!
text: A great wonderful tour in which we learned about the history of the Gothic quarter and the history of the Jewish community that thrived here in the beginnings of this city. Are torgai and Roger was very insightful and patient as we took pictures and asked questions along the way.
author: jennc1013
